note: Set B binds real member designations to components (W8X10, W10X12, PL5X3/8, L3X3X1/4 with the correct Detail C1 condition, HSS 4x4x1/4) and keeps the TYP condition and the 1 1/2" = 1'-0" scale, while Set A labels most dimensions only as "structural element | dimension" and omits the W8X10/W10X12/HSS/PL5X3/8 designations entirely. Set A also invents a "duct framing height 6' ft" (no 6' appears on the page) and misassigns the 8" and L3x3x1/4" items that belong to the C1 floor framing cluster to "Detail 2", plus it repeats the 1/4" TYP, PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2, 1 13/16" and 1" facts twice. Set B is not clean either — the weld claim quotes "1/4\" V" which is absent from the text layer, the HSS quote misreads the keynote number 05 12 23.A7 as "05", and it duplicates L3X3X1/4 as "member 1"/"member 2" and 1/4" TYP twice — but its errors are fewer and its claims are more usefully bound.
remarks: Text layer is a flat token stream with no detail grouping, so detail-to-dimension binding has to come from the image; the 8"/5 1/8"/1 3/8"/5/8"/L3x3x1/4"/HSS/PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2 cluster sits in the C1 FLOOR FRAMING DETAIL, and the 6 7/8"/6"/2"/1"/1 13/16"/11 1/2"/1'-3"/4" cluster in the C2 duct framing detail. Both sets miss the W10X15, L4X4X5/16 and C3X6 member designations and the 2'-4 1/2" and 1'-3" dimensions. B's weld claim ("1/4\" V") cannot be verified from the text layer and is not legible at this image resolution; weld symbols in general are hard to read here. Several claims in both sets attach invented attribute names ("offset", "spacing", "offset distance", "internal clearance width") to plain linear dimensions that the drawing does not label as such.
